# NCSES published aggregate workbook fixtures

Downloaded from the official fixed URLs on 2026-11-01. Original XLSX bytes are
unchanged; tests do not access the network. Amount cells are millions of dollars.
These are published aggregate tabulations, not the raw PitchBook database.

| File | Publication | Underlying source access | SHA-256 |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `nsb20204-tabs08-062.xlsx` | NCSES NSB-2020-4, Table S8-62, published 2020-01-15 | PitchBook, 2019-09-21 | `0843cb1cd56197d5ecb56ec7984e1dae9542a74f0a7cbcce6371593d4cdcc039` |
| `nsb20262-figtrn-028.xlsx` | NCSES NSB-2026-2, Figure TRN-28, published 2026-05-01 | PitchBook special tabulations, May 2025 | `8dfc5e74464e76f2c6fcabe1220b2f689d70a014090771472f7f9d6d45973245` |

- [Historical workbook](https://ncses.nsf.gov/pubs/nsb20204/assets/supplemental-tables/tables/nsb20204-tabs08-062.xlsx)
- [Recent workbook](https://ncses.nsf.gov/pubs/nsb20262/assets/business-dynamics-and-investment/figures/nsb20262-figtrn-028.xlsx)
- [NCSES permissions](https://ncses.nsf.gov/indicators/permissions): free reuse of
  NCSES material unless copyright is specifically noted. No table-specific
  copyright notice was observed; preserve NCSES and PitchBook attribution.

Historical cells B5:U5 are the explicit Global total; current cells I5:I16
are the explicit World total. Country/region sums do not replace those cells.
The editions revise overlapping years and remain distinct datasets.
